# Kshitiz Trigunayat

> Portfolio of Kshitiz Trigunayat — an AI product engineer and growth strategist based in Bengaluru, building LLM-powered products and zero-CAC growth engines. Built Planiva, co-founder of DnC Ventures, currently Associate Product Manager at Ctruh.

The site is an editorial portfolio with deep-dive case studies (event photos live inside each project), a biographical timeline, and a writing section linking to essays on Medium.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Hero with stat strip, selected work, about, capabilities, timeline, writing, and contact.
- [Timeline](/timeline): The full journey from Soron, Uttar Pradesh (2004) to Bengaluru (2026).

## Case studies

- [Planiva](/work/planiva): Agentic AI for event management — LangGraph, Postgres + pgvector, Twilio. First draft of an ₹8L, 150-guest wedding plan ready in 15 minutes vs 16–22 hours manually. TiE Global finalist.
- [Ctruh Technologies](/work/ctruh): Associate Product Manager, Jul 2026–present. Owns Ctruh Academy (learning platform), the internal Ctruh CMS and Ctruh Studio v1 end to end, plus social media marketing and launch events; QA on the marketplace.
- [DnC Ventures](/work/dnc-ventures): Co-founder, Sep 2024–present. ₹1Cr+ revenue, five divisions, 300+ ambassadors across 200+ institutions, 750K+ footfall, clients include Infinix Mobiles, MSI India, Swish, Krafton and many more.
- [Campus Clash India](/work/campus-clash): Own esports IP under DnC — 13,456 players, 2,988 teams, Grand Finals at IIT Kharagpur with 7,500+ footfall.
- [WrestleFan Entertainment](/work/wrestlefan): Financials, revenue projections and GTM for Shark Tank India Season 5.
- [Zordie AI](/work/zordie-ai): Resume intelligence system — 30% faster hiring cycle, 60% better B2C candidate success.
- [NASSCOM AI in Manufacturing](/work/nasscom-ai-curriculum): Four course modules designed with Naxxatra Sciences for FutureSkills Prime.
- [Jio Games](/work/jio-games): Good Game Show auditions — 20+ colleges, 40+ person ground team, zero critical failures.

## Writing

Essays on [Medium](https://medium.com/@kshitiz52.525).

- [Desportz](/work/desportz): Freelance Faculty Member, Desportz (Institute of Esports Training & Academics), Jul–Aug 2026: Esports Management Program, teaching Esports Marketing and Business Development modules.
